blocks.content: This stage will focus on creating a functional but minimalist hangman game for building the logical base of the project.Let's look at the project workflow step-by-step:

items: Choose a word for the player to guess.
Get character input from the player.
Check if the input is a valid character.
Check if the input is a correct guess or not based on the chosen word.
If incorrect, increment the number of misses.
Display the game status after every guess.
Continue the gameplay until the maximum number of misses is reached or the player guesses the complete word.

blocks.content: To make our code easy to read and maintain, we'll create two separate classes:

items: Game - to handle all the logic of the game
Message - to handle all the messages and displayed texts

blocks.content: Then, we'll use the main() function to create the objects of these classes and add some additional game logic.
